review_scope: Read all 179 canonical Chinese paragraphs and all 358 English/German paragraphs side by side, plus every title, deck, chapter and entry door, after reading the writer self-review. Compared all examples, qualifiers, rhetorical contrasts and conclusions: need versus ownership; promises, transition and care obligations; changed wishes without erased responsibilities; authenticity of the past without indefinite obligation to stay; unequal costs of refusal and decision authority; help enabling freedom from dependence without abrupt withdrawal of support. Corrected nine localized precision/idiom points after reading. Supporting checks passed for all ten files: renderer.load, exact ordered HTML tags and link targets, paragraph alignment, source identifiers, and chapter equality with index chapter6. Source and pending-decision bytes verified unchanged.
limitations: AI linguistic review, not human certification. Scope is en/de articles26–30 only. No rendered browser/visual QA or public writes. No source, index, other translations, commit or push changes. Writer self-review remains historical; final independent hashes here supersede hashes for corrected files.

findings.before: Some people ultimately continue a relationship out of responsibility alone. They no longer want to, but believe that leaving would make the other person unable to go on living. Staying appears to prove love, while in fact both people are trapped in need.
findings.after: Some people ultimately continue a relationship out of responsibility alone. They no longer want to, but believe that leaving would make the other person unable to manage their life. Staying appears to prove love, while in fact both people are trapped in need.
findings.issue: Avoid intensifying inability to manage life into literal inability to remain alive.

findings.before: Manche führen eine Beziehung schließlich nur noch aus Verantwortung fort. Sie wollen nicht mehr, glauben aber, der andere könnte nach ihrem Weggang nicht weiterleben. Das Bleiben scheint Liebe zu beweisen, tatsächlich sind beide in der Bedürftigkeit gefangen.
findings.after: Manche führen eine Beziehung schließlich nur noch aus Verantwortung fort. Sie wollen nicht mehr, glauben aber, der andere könnte nach ihrem Weggang sein Leben nicht mehr bewältigen. Das Bleiben scheint Liebe zu beweisen, tatsächlich sind beide in der Bedürftigkeit gefangen.
findings.issue: Avoid intensifying inability to manage life into literal inability to remain alive.

findings.before: The other person needs to distinguish whether they are asking for responsibility or demanding that their partner continue to be the person they once were.
findings.after: The other person needs to distinguish whether they are asking for responsibility or demanding that the other person continue to be the person they once were.
findings.issue: Keep relationship scope broad rather than suggesting only romantic partners.

findings.before: Sometimes a relationship remains yet has not allowed change: one person withdraws their own direction solely to restore peace.
findings.after: Sometimes a relationship remains yet has not allowed change: one person gives up their chosen direction solely to restore peace.
findings.issue: Naturalize abandoning a direction, without changing the peace-restoration motive.

findings.before: Manchmal bleibt eine Beziehung bestehen und hat Veränderung dennoch nicht zugelassen: Einer nimmt seine eigene Richtung zurück, nur um den Frieden wiederherzustellen.
findings.after: Manchmal bleibt eine Beziehung bestehen und hat Veränderung dennoch nicht zugelassen: Einer gibt seinen eigenen Weg auf, nur um den Frieden wiederherzustellen.
findings.issue: Naturalize abandoning a direction rather than retracting a direction.

findings.before: Commitment requires taking responsibility for the consequences of change, but cannot freeze someone forever in the direction of their past.
findings.after: Commitment requires taking responsibility for the consequences of change, but cannot freeze someone forever in their earlier direction.
findings.issue: Remove awkward phrasing while preserving the direction previously chosen.

findings.before: Gemeinsamkeit bedeutet nicht, alles gleich aufzuteilen, sondern das Gewicht der Entscheidung mit dem tatsächlich Getragenen zu verbinden.
findings.after: Gemeinsamkeit bedeutet nicht, alles gleich aufzuteilen, sondern das Gewicht der Mitsprache mit dem zu verbinden, was jemand tatsächlich trägt.
findings.issue: Clarify that the weight of a person’s say tracks what that person actually bears, rather than the importance of the decision.

findings.before: Does Loving Someone Include Letting Them No Longer Depend on You?
findings.after: Does Loving Someone Include Letting Them No Longer Have to Depend on You?
findings.issue: Restore 不必: not having to depend, rather than requiring dependence to cease.

findings.before: Ihn nicht mehr auf dich angewiesen sein zu lassen heißt auch anzuerkennen: Selbst nachdem er Fähigkeiten erworben hat, ist er noch immer nicht dein Werk.
findings.after: Ihm zu ermöglichen, nicht mehr auf dich angewiesen zu sein, heißt auch anzuerkennen: Selbst nachdem er Fähigkeiten erworben hat, ist er noch immer nicht dein Werk.
findings.issue: Naturalize enabling freedom from dependence rather than an awkward lassen construction.

source_notes: Article28 paragraph4 uses a reaching metaphor toward the earlier past; English backward and German rückwärts are accepted contextual temporal renderings, not source amendments.
source_decisions: Earlier decisions03/10 remain pending and unchanged.
